hook: Tunneling-microscope spectra can reveal spin entanglement in nanographene chains
summary: The authors show that features of inelastic tunneling spectra, including the number of active transitions and their spectral moments, encode entanglement between neighboring spin-1/2 sites. Applying the relations to measured nanographene spin chains gave good agreement with theory. The links are derived for idealized spin-1/2 models, and real systems with other interactions may fit less cleanly.
title: Imaging spin entanglement with a scanning tunneling microscope
